## AREA DEFINED FOR ARTICLE 13 MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING

This will confirm our understanding of May 31 1992, whereby it was agreed that notwithstanding the definition of the term "Area" as contained in Article 1, Paragraph 1.2 said term shall, solely for the purposes of Article 13, Paragraph 2.92, mean the Areas as described below:
